title: The Autopsy of Windrow House
author: Juniper Quintana
blurb: Marguerite Ashgrove, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
